evaluation_policy: Both unchanged checkpoints once at probability>=0.5. Primary TP/FN and recall on consensus PV pixels; no whole-array or roof recall. Background FP/TN and unscored ignored predictions separate. No derived precision/IoU/Dice presented as full-mask performance.
limits: Partial AI consensus can miss PV or preferentially retain easy interiors; recall is only on labelled pixels.
Positive and negative pilots share an acquisition cohort and geography; do not combine their class-screened scores into representative prevalence.
All 421 original PV4GER test images and the seven negative-pilot rasters remain outside this positive evaluation.
No training, seed/threshold/model tuning or label expansion from predictions.
review_policy: Two separate blind full-native-image reviews on all thirteen crops. Approve-positive only for clearly recognizable photovoltaic module surfaces. Draw visible module footprints and resolved gaps, not array bounding rectangles. Independently mark clear background; occlusion, uncertain collectors and unclear boundaries remain ignored. No confirmed PV or unresolved overall identification => defer. Consensus PV=intersection, consensus BG=intersection; disagreement and all other pixels ignored. Both approve and at least 100 consensus PV pixels required. No filling quota or changing the gate after review.
selection_policy: Exactly the thirteen unassigned cases from the prior negative review cohort. The seven previously inferred negative cases are excluded. No new RGB requests or prediction-based selection. Same geographically separate external acquisition cohort, not a statistically independent new regional sample.
